findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in document reads
findings.body: Returning true unconditionally allows users to read documents belonging to any tenant. Any caller relying on this exported authorization function now permits cross-tenant data access because both tenant identifiers are ignored.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: When a document belongs to a different tenant, `canReadDocument` still returns `true` because the ownership comparison was replaced with an unconditional allow. This permits cross-tenant document reads for every caller relying on this authorization function.
